visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-definition close-up of a finished culinary dish featuring large golden-fried shrimp topped with fried peanuts and chopped scallions in a textured black bowl. A large title text overlay appears at the top. (2) A male chef in a professional white uniform with black accents stands in a bright indoor studio environment with a white faux-brick background. He holds a clear plastic bag containing raw shrimp and demonstrates adding white starch powder from a yellow lid, smiling and speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (3) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a black frying pan on an induction cooktop where clear oil is poured and several starch-coated shrimp are placed to sizzle. The shrimp's color gradually shifts from translucent grey to a vibrant orange-pink with a crispy golden exterior. (4) The chef is shown back in the studio setting, shaking the plastic bag vigorously to coat the shrimp evenly, maintaining a friendly and energetic facial expression. (5) Close-up shots follow, showing the chef flipping the shrimp in the pan with a spatula and then draining excess oil into a small glass bowl. Chopped green scallions and a bowl of spicy peanuts with a red seasoning packet are introduced. (6) The final assembly involves tossing the fried shrimp with the scallions and peanuts in the pan under warm indoor lighting, culminating in a repeat of the high-angle beauty shot of the plated dish.
